education.details:
Thesis: Maveshi (Digitizing local cattle farms)
Conducted qualitative user research with local cattle farmers to identify key pain points in their traditional, paper-based farm management. The findings from these interviews directly informed the development of Maveshi, a mobile application designed to digitize cattle records. The platform facilitates the management of animal profiles, milking records, and lineage, aiming to improve data accuracy and operational efficiency for farmers by replacing conventional paper diaries.

publications.title: On the Adoption of AI Coding Agents in Open-source Android and iOS Development
publications.authors: Muhammad Ahmad Khan, Hasnain Ali, Muneeb Rana, Muhammad Saqib Ilyas, Abdul Ali Bangash
publications.summary: The first category-level empirical study of AI-agent-generated code in open-source mobile development, analyzing 2,901 AI-authored pull requests across 193 Android and iOS repositories. We find Android receives more AI-authored PRs with higher acceptance rates than iOS, routine tasks (features, fixes, UI) succeed more often than structural changes (refactors, builds), and PR resolution time improved through mid-2025 before declining.
publications.venue: IEEE 23rd International Mining Software Repositories Conference (MSR '26), Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
